<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="utf-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
  <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark">
  <title>0</title>
  <link rel="icon" href="data:,">
  <style>
    *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%; text-size-adjust: 100%; }
    body {
      margin: 0 auto;
      max-width: 65ch;
      padding: 1rem;
      font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    input, button, textarea, select { font: inherit; }
    h1, h2, h3 { line-height: 1.2; text-wrap: balance; }
    p { text-wrap: pretty; }
    p, li, h1, h2, h3 { overflow-wrap: break-word; }
    img, svg, video { max-width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; }
    :focus-visible { outline: 2px solid currentColor; outline-offset: 2px; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      *, *::before, *::after { animation-duration: 0.01ms !important; animation-iteration-count: 1 !important; transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <main>

</body>
</html>

I didn't change anything yet. `0.html` is an empty boilerplate: the `<main>` has no content. The base is already solid. It has a viewport meta, dark-mode support, a readable line length, balanced headings, visible focus outlines and reduced-motion handling.

"Improve" could mean a few different things here, so what do you want it to do?

1. **Harden the boilerplate** with small tweaks:
   - add a `<meta name="description">` and a real `<title>`
   - add `hanging-punctuation`
   - let `svg` stay inline instead of turning it into a block
   - style `code` and `pre`
   - add a skip link
2. **Give it content**, like a landing page, an article template or a demo of some component.
3. **Add a visual design**, such as a color palette, fonts and a light/dark theme using `light-dark()`.

I'd suggest option 1 if this is meant as a reusable starter file. If you tell me what the page is for, I'll build that instead.
